description: Header file defining the log_likelihood_ratio class for representing and manipulating log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) in a communication system. Includes methods for saturated arithmetic, conversion, quantization, and operations like soft XOR.

classes.name: log_likelihood_ratio
classes.description: Class representing log-likelihood ratios with saturated arithmetic, conversion, and various operations.

methods.name: quantize
methods.description: Quantizes a float value into a log_likelihood_ratio within a specified range.

methods.name: promotion_sum
methods.description: Performs a promotion sum, setting results beyond LLR_MAX to infinity.

methods.name: copysign
methods.description: Returns an LLR with the magnitude of the first argument and the sign of the second.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of an LLR.

methods.name: soft_xor
methods.description: Performs a soft XOR operation between two LLRs using an approximation.

methods.name: norm_squared
methods.description: Calculates the squared Euclidean norm of a sequence of LLRs.

methods.name: dot_prod_sign
methods.description: Computes the dot product of LLRs and sign sequence.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Performs a saturated sum of two sequences of LLRs.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps input LLR values between specified bounds.
